::: {.en}
The approvals for a waste-to-energy plant, and CDEG's own corporate approvals, are on [Approval pathways](pathways.qmd). Emission standards are on [Australia vs China regulation](china-comparison.qmd). The table below compares the states.

**Why sorting matters for the furnace.** The more food a state takes out of the red bin, the richer and smaller its residual stream becomes (3.3). Victoria and NSW both mandate FOGO by 2030, so residual waste in the two largest markets will move towards the top of CDEG's grate window over a plant's life.
:::

::: {.zh}
- 维州：250万吨上限、填埋税177.19澳元/吨、2030年前全部家庭实行FOGO。
- 新州：仅限指定区域建设焚烧厂，填埋税180.20澳元/吨。
- 西澳：已建成两座大型焚烧厂（Kwinana、East Rockingham）。
- 昆州：填埋税上涨最快。
- 南澳：规模较小。
- 维州是首选市场。
